external_reference_status: Photo-derived: the image stage received crops of the owner's own photographs of a facade in Freiburg im Breisgau (ornaments) and of the Fischbrunnen, a Gothic fountain on the Muensterplatz (statues, canopy). The photographs are named and hashed in each image record, not distributed. The generated clean images were then uploaded to Meshy.
dimension_basis: Sizes as placed in the Ginkgo photo reconstructions (fountain.json statue heights; pink.json console height; placement matrices for canopy and cartouche); height normalised exactly, width and depth measured after uniform scaling. Measured from photographs, not surveyed.
rights: Image and mesh stages ran on the owner's paid Meshy account; the inputs were the owner's own photographs. The fountain statues and canopy reproduce a 15th-century public monument and the ornaments an 1890s facade; their original designs are long out of copyright, and no photograph is distributed. Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-18. These models also appear inside the owner's GRANDWHIS world packs. Generator account entitlements and the current monument's restoration history not independently audited.
estimated_credits: 0 for this import (generation already paid in Ginkgo: 6-9 Meshy credits per image and 30 per mesh)
